cover.title: Why Is Car Repair So Expensive?

lines.text: Car repairs cost 55% more than in January 2020 (Jan 2020 to Aug 2026, BLS CPI).
lines.say: Car repairs cost fifty-five percent more than in January twenty twenty.

lines.text: In the year to August 2026, BLS data shows repair up 5.2% and car insurance down 5.1%.
lines.say: In the year to August twenty twenty-six, repair rose five point two percent while car insurance fell five point one percent.

lines.text: Why? Cars are packed with sensors, and CCC found calibrations on about 28% of repair estimates in 2025, up from about 22%.
lines.say: Why? Cars are packed with sensors, and C C C found calibrations on about twenty-eight percent of repair estimates in twenty twenty-five, up from about twenty-two.

lines.text: The average collision repair took 26.7 labor hours in 2025, up from 23.0 in 2012 but below the 2023 peak (CCC).
lines.say: The average collision repair took twenty-six point seven labor hours in twenty twenty-five, up from twenty-three in twenty twelve but off its twenty twenty-three peak.

lines.text: Median mechanic pay: $24.34 an hour in May 2025 (BLS). In fall 2024, 49% of shops PartsTech surveyed billed $120 to $159 an hour.
lines.say: Median mechanic pay was twenty-four dollars and thirty-four cents an hour in May twenty twenty-five. In fall twenty twenty-four, forty-nine percent of surveyed shops billed a hundred twenty to a hundred fifty-nine dollars an hour.

lines.text: If a $100 repair in January 2020 rose with the index, it would cost about $155 by August 2026.
lines.say: If a hundred dollar repair in January twenty twenty rose with the index, it would cost about a hundred fifty-five dollars by August twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Car repairs cost 55% more than in Jan 2020. Here's why.
post.ig:
Car repair prices rose 55% from January 2020 to August 2026 (BLS CPI).
BLS CPI, 12 months to August 2026: repair +5.2%, car insurance -5.1%.
CCC Intelligent Solutions: average collision repair $3,421 in 2020, $4,818 in 2025 (preliminary).
CCC: calibrations on about 28% of repair estimates in 2025, up from about 22%; 26.7 labor hours per average repair in 2025 vs 23.0 in 2012.
BLS median mechanic pay was $24.34/hr in May 2025; 49% of shops in a fall 2024 PartsTech survey billed $120-$159/hr.
Sources: BLS, CCC Intelligent Solutions, PartsTech.
News and education, not financial advice.
